assert_is_instance_check_type: assert an object is an instance of a given class and raise TypeError if not
assert_is_instance_validate_return: validate and return an object only if it matches the expected class type
none_throws_guard_none: raise a ValueError when a value is None instead of allowing it to propagate
none_throws_custom_message: throw a ValueError with a custom message when a variable is unexpectedly None
none_throws_safe_unwrap: safely unwrap an optional value and raise an error if it is None
